$doc: §23.6 ST-3. The levels are authored: StochasticUnitDefend stamps Hasty at occupation and climbs by sim time (600 s / 3600 s), so a play-driven version would need a 3700 s run; the combat reads AggregateUnit.Prepared directly (StochasticCombat.CoverFactor: 0.45 Prepared, 0.25 Fortified). The attackers are COMPANIES (90 men) against 30-man defenders so the losses are not one or two slots. Measured at 90 s: the Prepared defender has 6 slots down (7 damaged), the Fortified one 5 - the order the rows pin; both sides' fight is over by then.

expect.name: the Fortified defender is fought: a slot is down
the Prepared defender loses at least 6 men
the Fortified defender never loses 6 men (it loses fewer than the Prepared one)
